title: Service binary
what: The bmo-telegram binary: it reads the configuration, builds the provider, mounts the routes and serves them, with the repository's two units and testbed declaration beside it.

title: Service configuration
what: The service's configuration read from the environment: the loopback ports, the Bot API address, the receiver and reader addresses and tokens, the data folder, picture root and sticker set.

title: Service router
what: The service as one router: bmo-chat's provider routes, the seam's routes the reader calls and the repository's own status, all under the one token, with the reader's health kept current.
